another department page describes only the first year as guaranteed."],[11,"University of Utah","United States","Computing PhD","PhD","Competitive Options","Standard full funding","Computing PhD students receive financial support while in the program and making good progress; current rates include fall and spring pay, possible summer RA support, tuition benefit, and health insurance."],[12,"North Carolina State University at Raleigh","United States","Computer Science PhD","PhD","High Reaches","Guaranteed full funding","Every fall PhD admit who requests aid receives a four-year package with tuition, individual health insurance, and stipend; student fees and most summers are excluded."],[13,"Vanderbilt University","United States","Computer Science PhD","PhD","High Reaches","Standard full funding","Computer Science PhD students receive a competitive stipend, full tuition waiver, and health insurance through RA or TA appointments."],[14,"Boston University","United States","PhD in Computer Science","PhD","High Reaches","Guaranteed full funding","Charles River Campus PhD students in good standing are guaranteed five years of 12-month stipend support, full tuition and required fees, and a health-insurance credit; international students are included."],[15,"Carnegie Mellon University","United States","Software Engineering PhD","PhD","Extreme Reaches","Guaranteed full funding","The Software Engineering PhD advertises guaranteed research and teaching assistantships covering tuition and living expenses."]]}
